beats.text: Mozambique has 0.2% of adults with a Master's degree. Georgia has 24.9%.
Mozambique is the world's lowest. Very few adults reach this level of study.
Global giants are often lower. China has 0.9%, while Japan has 2.5%.
The USA has 15%. This counts everyone age 25 and over who attained or completed a Master's or equivalent degree.
The leaderboard climbs through Poland at 21.4%, Estonia at 21.8%, and Slovakia at 22.3%.
Georgia is among the highest at 24.9%. That is 10 times the rate in Japan.
How many adults hold a Master's degree where you live?
